svg.title: Thus L = 2K suffices. Reference injectivity follows from correlation functionals separating the free quotient; their basis matrix is G. The lift retains equation ideal, projection, trained columns, response functionals and ordered choices. Recovery preserves their finite rank and stability proof on the same varying projected columns, with the banked and Wick dependencies retained explicitly. For explicit coefficient-space recovery, let pE read coefficient data and jE be its section, with pEjE = IE. Define bπi = jEπipE, bLi = LipE.
